latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Fully featured FAERS-based multi-drug single-SOC safety comparison study planner.

- Generates comprehensive research designs for comparative safety studies using FAERS/OpenFDA data within one System Organ Class (SOC).
- Always outputs four plan configurations (Lite, Standard, Advanced, Publication+) with clear comparison tables, step-by-step workflows, and figure/validation plans.
- Supports various pharmacovigilance study styles, including drug class vs active comparator, within-class head-to-head, PT-level deepening, and publication-ready protocols.
- Minimal user input required: drug set, comparator, and target SOC or AE domain.
- Output structured for seamless handoff to data analysis and academic writing tools; includes minimal executable plan and upgrade path for publication.
